name: @gcrft123/tailr
description: Mark up a running dev server and hand the changes to your coding agent as one batch.
author: gcrft123

scripts.version: node scripts/changelog.js --release && node scripts/plugin.js --sync && git add CHANGELOG.md .claude-plugin .cursor-plugin .github/plugin .agents plugin gemini-extension.json skills
scripts.postversion:
node -e "console.log('
  Tagged v' + require('./package.json').version + ' locally. Nothing has shipped yet.

  Push the tag to release it:

    git push --follow-tags
')"
